title: Input Event Envelope
description: Frozen v1.0 schema for the input event envelope whose canonical hash is recorded as input_hash in an AI inference receipt.

schema_version.description: Schema version discriminator. Must be exactly 'event-envelope/v1'.

event_id.description: Globally unique event identifier. Must match the event_id in the corresponding receipt.

source.description: Identifier of the upstream system that emitted this event.

payload.description: Opaque event payload. The SHA-256 of the canonical bytes of the entire envelope (including this field) is recorded as input_hash.

emitted_at.description: Wall-clock timestamp at which the event was emitted. Included in input_hash because it is part of the envelope.
